domain.description: Portrait photography, portrait retouching, product photography, composition optimization, Hanfu portrait shooting, lighting schemes, and photo post-production references.

caption_schema_notes: Photography domain accepts tutorial_reference, shooting_recipe, retouching_recipe, reference_image, case_image, rejected_image, and comparison_set rows. Web tutorial rows are metadata-only and must not include scraped tutorial images or full article text.
rights_notes: Raw reference images remain outside git. Store source links, summaries, date accessed, training use, and rights status only.
negative_training_boundary: do not train plastic skin as beauty
do not erase skin pores or facial identity
do not change body or face anatomy unless explicitly requested and ethically acceptable
do not generate fake product labels or warped brand text
do not mix studio light direction with outdoor background shadows
do not use Hanfu or cultural styling as generic costume decoration without scene and etiquette coherence
